versions.changelog:
- Updated setup instructions to clarify where to obtain your API key and manage billing/recharge (now at pipispy.com).
- Added links and guidance for accessing the real-time dashboard and product UI at pipiads.com.
- No changes to APIs or core functionality.

Initial release of the tiktok-made-me-buy-it skill:

- Enables discovery of TikTok natural traffic videos and organic product-picking signals using PipiAds tools.
- Provides the `search_natural_videos` tool to filter videos by plays, likes, followers, and keywords.
- Designed exclusively for organic content research, not for paid ad or TikTok Shop analytics.
- Requires a PipiAds API key and npm-based server setup.
- Clear usage boundaries and workflow guidance included.
